from pathlib import Path
for name in ['main.db','main.db-wal']:
    p=Path(name)
    b=p.read_bytes()
    print('\n',name,'size',len(b))
    print('first 128 hex:',b[:128].hex(' '))
    print('first 128 repr:',repr(b[:128]))
    print('magic ascii:',repr(b[:16]))
    if name.endswith('-wal'):
        print('header ints big-endian:')
        import struct
        print('magic',hex(struct.unpack('>I',b[0:4])[0]))
        print('format',struct.unpack('>I',b[4:8])[0])
        print('page size',struct.unpack('>I',b[8:12])[0])
        print('checkpoint seq',struct.unpack('>I',b[12:16])[0])
        print('salt1',hex(struct.unpack('>I',b[16:20])[0]),'salt2',hex(struct.unpack('>I',b[20:24])[0]))
        print('cksum1',hex(struct.unpack('>I',b[24:28])[0]),'cksum2',hex(struct.unpack('>I',b[28:32])[0]))

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
b=Path('main.db-wal').read_bytes()
ps=4096
print('size',len(b),'frames',(len(b)-32)//(24+ps))
for i in range((len(b)-32)//(24+ps)):
    h=bytes(x^0x42 for x in b[32+i*(24+ps):56+i*(24+ps)])
    pg,dbsz,s1,s2,c1,c2=struct.unpack('>6I',h)
    data=bytes(x^0x42 for x in b[56+i*(24+ps):56+i*(24+ps)+16])
    print(i,'page',pg,'dbsize',dbsz,'salt',hex(s1),hex(s2),'ck',hex(c1),hex(c2),'data',repr(data))
